usage.guide: POST to https://x402.orth.sh/parallel/chat/completions with a JSON body {"model":"speed","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]} and pay the $0.01 x402 charge (USDC on Base). It returns an OpenAI ChatCompletions JSON object; read the answer at body.choices[0].message.content. For web-research-grounded answers use a heavier model (base/core) and inspect body.basis[] for citations. You can request structured output via response_format. Plain synchronous call, no auth beyond x402.
